tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

**Goal:** Turn user intent into a hardened, reviewable artifact.

**CRITICAL:** If a step directs you to another snapshot file, read it fully and follow it. No exceptions.

Subagents, when the capability is available, are an important part of this workflow. Use them as directed by the workflow steps.
If you need an explicit user instruction to run them, ask once now for the whole workflow run.

## READY FOR DEVELOPMENT STANDARD

A specification is "Ready for Development" when:

- **Actionable**: Every task has a file path and specific action.
- **Logical**: Tasks ordered by dependency.
- **Testable**: All ACs use Given/When/Then.
- **Complete**: No placeholders or TBDs.
- **Sufficient**: No known requirement, acceptance, dependency, or implementation gaps remain unresolved.
- **Coherent**: No unresolved ambiguities or internal contradictions.

## SCOPE STANDARD

A specification should target a **single user-facing goal** within **900–1600 tokens**:

- **Single goal**: One cohesive feature, even if it spans multiple layers/files. Multi-goal means >=2 **top-level independent shippable deliverables** — each could be reviewed, tested, and merged as a separate PR without breaking the others. Never count surface verbs, "and" conjunctions, or noun phrases. Never split cross-layer implementation details inside one user goal.
  - Split: "add dark mode toggle AND refactor auth to JWT AND build admin dashboard"
  - Don't split: "add validation and display errors" / "support drag-and-drop AND paste AND retry"
- **900–1600 tokens**: Optimal range for LLM consumption. Below 900 risks ambiguity; above 1600 risks context-rot in implementation agents.
- **Neither limit is a gate.** Both are proposals with user override.

## Conventions

- Every operational cross-file reference in this workflow is an absolute snapshot path. Open it directly; do not resolve it relative to a skill directory.
- `{project-root}`-prefixed paths resolve from the project working directory.
- Whenever this workflow captures or records a version-control revision, obtain the full canonical identifier directly from version control and preserve it verbatim.

- **Sequential Enforcement**: Complete steps in order, no skipping

# Epic 2 Context: Biometric Authentication Vault

<!-- Compiled from planning artifacts. Edit freely. Regenerate with compile-epic-context if planning docs change. -->

## Goal

Put a device-validated access barrier in front of every screen that shows user data: Face ID or Touch ID with a PIN fallback, cold-start and after a fixed idle timeout, with zero lockout path and zero biometric data or call ever reaching the backend. This closes the one entry point into the app that Epic 1 left as a placeholder, and every later feature's data is only ever reachable once this gate has passed.

## Stories

- Story 2.1: Biometric/PIN App-Access Gate
- Story 2.2: Biometric-Failure Fallback to PIN
- Story 2.3: Fixed 5-Minute Idle Re-Authentication Timeout
- Story 2.4: Biometric Preference Persistence

## Requirements & Constraints

- No screen other than the vault/login screen is reachable before authentication succeeds, on cold start and after the idle timeout.
- Biometric validation is 100% on-device; no biometric data or biometric call ever reaches the backend. `AuthInvalid` can only ever originate from password login — never from a local vault/PIN check, so no vault failure is ever mapped to that Failure subtype.
- A failed biometric attempt always offers a PIN entry path — never a dead end, never a lockout. An OS-level lockout from repeated biometric failures is detected and routed to the app's own PIN fallback, not retried against the OS.
- The idle re-authentication timeout is exactly 5 minutes, fixed and not user-configurable: resuming before 5 minutes prompts nothing; resuming at or after 5 minutes always prompts re-authentication, regardless of any user setting.
- The biometric on/off preference is persisted server-side via `PATCH /account/settings` (surfacing the standard Failure contract on error), not cached only on-device — it is re-fetched from the account on every app load, including after reinstall. Disabling biometrics still leaves PIN as the access method; the vault itself can never be fully turned off.
- Performance floor applies as elsewhere: local UI interactions <100ms; any network call >300ms shows a loading indicator.

## Technical Decisions

- New module `features/vault/` owns this epic. It exposes a `VaultStatus` stream from `features/vault/domain`, mirroring how `features/auth/domain` exposes `SessionStatus` — registered once in DI as a singleton, same pattern, no second instance.
- The single `go_router` top-level redirect (already scaffolded by Epic 1/F000 for `SessionStatus`) is extended, not rebuilt: it composes exactly two gates in fixed order — `VaultStatus` first, then `SessionStatus` — because the vault gates whether anything may be shown at all, before any network/session state is considered. Neither gate ever makes a network call to validate itself.
- Biometrics via `local_auth` (^3.0.2); any local secret (e.g. PIN) via `flutter_secure_storage` (^11.2.0). `NSFaceIDUsageDescription` is required in `Info.plist` for Face ID (not for Touch ID). `local_auth`'s `biometryLockout`/`lockedOut` error has no programmatic reset — catch it and fall through to the app's own PIN path. `stickyAuth` behavior is relevant to resuming an in-flight check when the app returns to foreground.
- The 5-minute idle timeout is app logic (lifecycle observation on backgrounding/resuming), not plugin-provided, and must be implemented as a fixed parameter living inside `features/vault/domain` — explicitly not a shared `core/` constant — and is never re-tuned by any later story.
- The biometric preference toggle itself is persisted through `PATCH /account/settings`, which belongs to `features/account/` (not `features/vault/`) — story 2.4 is the point where a minimal Configurações screen is introduced (replacing Epic 1's placeholder) containing only this toggle; Epic 8 later extends the same screen with profile editing, dashboard, and account actions, so it is never recreated from scratch.
- Standard project-wide rules apply: domain layer imports neither `package:flutter` nor `data/`; repositories return `Either<Failure, T>`; no hardcoded visual values outside `design_tokens.dart`.

## UX & Interaction Patterns

- PIN keypad: numeric 3×4 grid + backspace, progress dots above, rendered entirely in the structural palette (no accent color on digits).
- PIN entry auto-advances 350ms after the 4th digit is entered — no explicit "confirm" tap.
- Biometric-failure copy: "Não foi possível reconhecer — digite seu PIN."
- Screen-reader labels must announce the failure transition (state changes, not just static state).
- The PIN keypad is one of the tightest-fit surfaces for Dynamic Type — digits must not truncate at the largest accessibility text size.
- Tap targets ≥44pt.

## Cross-Story Dependencies

- Depends on Epic 1/F000: the `go_router` redirect skeleton and the `SessionStatus` stream already exist (stories 1.5/1.6). This epic plugs the `VaultStatus` half into that same redirect rather than building a second, competing gate.
- Story 2.4 depends on `features/account/`'s `PATCH /account/settings` and introduces the Configurações screen shell that Epic 8 later extends — that screen must not be rebuilt from scratch in Epic 8.
- Within the epic, 2.1 (the gate itself) must exist before 2.2 (its failure fallback) and 2.3 (its timeout trigger) make sense; 2.4's persisted preference governs whether 2.1's gate is biometric-first or PIN-only, so it reads that preference at startup regardless of build order.

1	---
2	title: 'Fixed 5-Minute Idle Re-Authentication Timeout'
3	type: 'feature'
4	created: '2026-11-03'
5	status: 'done'
6	review_loop_iteration: 1
7	context: []
8	baseline_commit: '9f91f60d57c80cb38e382e925bc01701f12808b2'
9	---
10	
11	<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">
12	
13	## Intent
14	
15	**Problem:** Once `VaultRepository.currentStatus` flips to `unlocked` (cold-start biometric/PIN success, spec-2-1/2-2), nothing ever re-locks it — an unlocked app stays unlocked indefinitely if backgrounded and left unattended, with no idle-based re-authentication trigger at all.
16	
17	**Approach:** Have `VaultRepositoryImpl` observe app-lifecycle transitions directly (`WidgetsBindingObserver`): record a timestamp on backgrounding, and on resume compare elapsed time against a new fixed domain constant; crossing it re-emits `VaultStatus.locked` through the existing `_emit`/`statusStream` machinery. The already-shipped AD-14 redirect (`VaultStatus` checked before `SessionStatus`) then bounces every screen back to `/vault` on that emission with zero router changes.
18	
19	## Boundaries & Constraints
20	
21	**Always:** Fixed `Duration(minutes: 5)` lives in a new `features/vault/domain` file, never a shared `core/` constant, never re-tuned by any later story. Elapsed time read via an injectable `DateTime Function() now` constructor param (default `DateTime.now`) for deterministic tests. Backgrounded timestamp recorded on `AppLifecycleState.paused`, read/cleared on `AppLifecycleState.resumed` — `inactive`/`hidden` are not treated as "backgrounded" on their own. Only emits `VaultStatus.locked` when `currentStatus` is currently `unlocked` AND elapsed `>= 5` minutes — never redundantly if already locked, never before the threshold. `WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this)`/`removeObserver(this)` wired into the existing constructor/`dispose()` — no second observer, no new DI registration, no new `VaultStatus` enum value.
22	
23	**Ask First:** None.
24	
25	**Never:** No user-facing or account-level setting for this duration (fixed, not user-configurable — AC2). No `core/` constant. No new abstract method added to `VaultRepository`'s public contract. No changes to `app_router.dart` or `vault_lock_screen.dart` — the existing stream-driven redirect and `initState`-triggered `authenticate()` already cover re-prompting on relock.
26	
27	## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix
28	
29	| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
30	|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
31	| Backgrounded < 5 min, then resumed | `paused` at T0, was `unlocked`, `resumed` at T0+4min | `currentStatus` stays `unlocked`, no emission | N/A |
32	| Backgrounded >= 5 min, then resumed | `paused` at T0, was `unlocked`, `resumed` at T0+5min (or later) | `statusStream` emits `locked`, `currentStatus` flips to `locked` | N/A |
33	| Backgrounded >= 5 min while already locked | `paused` then `resumed` after >=5min, `currentStatus` already `locked` | stays `locked`, no duplicate emission | N/A |
34	| `resumed` fires with no prior `paused` | e.g. first lifecycle callback ever observed | no-op, no emission, no crash | N/A |
35	
36	</frozen-after-approval>
37	
38	## Code Map
39	
40	- `lib/features/vault/domain/vault_idle_timeout.dart` (new) — fixed `Duration(minutes: 5)` constant, domain-owned per epic Technical Decisions.
41	- `lib/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl.dart` — implement `WidgetsBindingObserver`; add `_backgroundedAt`/injectable `now` clock; `WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this)` in constructor, `.removeObserver(this)` in `dispose()` (`:163-165`); override `didChangeAppLifecycleState` to apply the I/O matrix via existing `_emit`.
42	- `test/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl_test.dart` — add an idle-timeout `group`, calling `didChangeAppLifecycleState` directly (it's a public override) with an injected fake clock — no real `WidgetsBinding` lifecycle event needed, matching the project's "no device/simulator" constraint.
43	
44	## Tasks & Acceptance
45	
46	**Execution:**
47	- [x] `lib/features/vault/domain/vault_idle_timeout.dart` -- create the fixed-duration constant -- Technical Decisions: domain-owned, not `core/`.
48	- [x] `lib/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl.dart` -- implement `WidgetsBindingObserver`, injectable clock, add/removeObserver wiring, `didChangeAppLifecycleState` logic -- per I/O matrix.
49	- [x] `test/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl_test.dart` -- cover all four I/O matrix rows -- regression coverage for the idle re-lock.
50	
51	**Acceptance Criteria:**
52	- Given the app is backgrounded for less than 5 minutes, when I resume it, then no re-authentication is prompted.
53	- Given the app is backgrounded for 5 minutes or more, when I resume it, then re-authentication is always prompted regardless of any user setting, with the fixed 5-minute value living in `features/vault/domain`, never a shared `core/` constant.
54	
55	### Review Findings
56	
57	- [x] [Review][Decision] Out-of-scope changes to `vault_lock_screen.dart` and `pin_keypad.dart` violate spec-2-3's explicit "Never" clause — this story's own frozen Boundaries say "No changes to `app_router.dart` or `vault_lock_screen.dart`," yet the diff attributed to this story (commit `81d7509`) modifies both `vault_lock_screen.dart` and the tightly-coupled `pin_keypad.dart` (the `submitPin` 10s timeout, the `PinKeypad.enabled` flag). Both are acknowledged leftover review fixes from story 2.2, bundled into this commit rather than committed separately. The idle-timeout logic itself fully complies with every other Boundary/Constraint and I/O-matrix row. — resolved: accepted as documented (see Spec Change Log below). The bundled fixes are real, correct, and already explained in `test-summary.md`/`deferred-work.md`; no code or history change made.
58	- [x] [Review][Patch] A biometric/PIN unlock that resolves while the app is still backgrounded can trigger an immediate re-lock the moment the app resumes — `authenticate()` uses `persistAcrossBackgrounding: true` so a pending call can resolve after a `paused` is recorded; if `_emit(unlocked)` fires while still backgrounded and `resumed` arrives ≥5 minutes after the original `paused` (e.g. a long phone call), `didChangeAppLifecycleState` immediately re-locks, bouncing the user straight back to `/vault` right after they authenticated. — fixed: `_emit` now clears `_backgroundedAt` whenever status is `unlocked`, so any unlock always resets the idle clock. Covered by a new test. [lib/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl.dart:132-151]
59	- [x] [Review][Patch] `submitPin()`'s UI-level 10s timeout doesn't cancel the underlying repository call, so a second attempt can race the first against the same storage key — once the UI times out and re-enables the keypad, the original `VaultRepository.submitPin()` call keeps running; if it later resolves, it can emit `unlocked` from a stale, abandoned attempt, or race a concurrent first-time PIN write with no generation/cancellation token to make a stale result a no-op. — fixed: added a `_submitPinGeneration` counter; a call whose generation is stale by the time its `read()` resolves returns `Left` without writing or emitting. Covered by a new test. [lib/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl.dart:96] [lib/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl.dart:229-243]
60	- [x] [Review][Patch] A second `paused` lifecycle event before any `resumed` silently resets the idle clock to the later timestamp — `didChangeAppLifecycleState` unconditionally overwrites `_backgroundedAt` on every `paused` with no check for an already-pending one, which can undercount true elapsed background time if `paused` ever fires twice without an intervening `resumed`. Not covered by the I/O matrix or tests. — fixed: `_backgroundedAt ??= _now()` keeps the earliest timestamp. Covered by a new test. [lib/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl.dart:167-173]
61	- [x] [Review][Patch] `PinKeypad`'s `enabled: false` state has no visual or semantic disabled treatment — taps are silently swallowed in `_onDigitTap`/`_onBackspaceTap`, but `Semantics(button: true, ...)` never sets `enabled: false` and nothing dims the buttons, so neither a sighted nor a VoiceOver user gets any "processing"/disabled cue for up to 10 seconds. — fixed: `_KeypadButton` now wraps in `Opacity` and sets `Semantics(enabled: ...)` and `onTap: null` when disabled. Covered by a new test. [lib/features/vault/presentation/widgets/pin_keypad.dart:231-282]
62	- [x] [Review][Patch] Stale error message lingers through a fresh PIN attempt with no "in progress" indicator — `_submitPin` never clears `_errorMessage` when a new attempt starts, so a previous mismatch/timeout message stays on screen unchanged through the new attempt. — fixed: `_errorMessage` is cleared in the same `setState` that sets `_submittingPin = true`. Covered by a new test. [lib/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen.dart:124-133]
63	- [x] [Review][Patch] Test file registers two `VaultRepositoryImpl` instances as `WidgetsBindingObserver` on the same shared `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding` — the top-level `setUp()`'s `repository` and the idle-timeout group's own `idleRepository` both register on the same binding, so the "real dispatch path" test's `handleAppLifecycleStateChanged(...)` notifies both simultaneously with no assertion covering the unintended side effect. Currently harmless (verified: full suite passes, `repository` never reaches `unlocked` in that group), but an unnecessary double registration. — fixed: the idle-timeout group's `setUp` now disposes the outer `repository` immediately, so only `idleRepository` is registered during this group's tests. [test/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl_test.dart]
64	- [x] [Review][Patch] Constructor's `WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this)` depends entirely on binding-init ordering, backed only by a comment — every current call site is correctly ordered (no live bug today), but there's no runtime assertion, so any future direct construction outside that ordering would crash with an opaque Flutter-binding error instead of a clear, intentional one. — fixed: wrapped in a `try`/`on FlutterError catch` that rethrows a `StateError` naming the actual root cause. [lib/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl.dart:69-77]
65	- [x] [Review][Patch] spec-2-3's own review-tracking metadata is incomplete and internally inconsistent — frontmatter `review_loop_iteration: 0` remains at its initial value even though this file's own "Suggested Review Order" section repeatedly says "Added in review," and unlike spec-2-1/spec-2-2 in this same diff, spec-2-3 has no populated `### Review Findings` section at all until this edit. — fixed: `review_loop_iteration` bumped to `1`; this section populated. [_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-2-3-fixed-5-minute-idle-re-authentication-timeout.md]

---
title: 'Fixed 5-Minute Idle Re-Authentication Timeout'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-03'
status: 'done'
review_loop_iteration: 1
context: []
baseline_commit: '9f91f60d57c80cb38e382e925bc01701f12808b2'
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Once `VaultRepository.currentStatus` flips to `unlocked` (cold-start biometric/PIN success, spec-2-1/2-2), nothing ever re-locks it — an unlocked app stays unlocked indefinitely if backgrounded and left unattended, with no idle-based re-authentication trigger at all.

**Approach:** Have `VaultRepositoryImpl` observe app-lifecycle transitions directly (`WidgetsBindingObserver`): record a timestamp on backgrounding, and on resume compare elapsed time against a new fixed domain constant; crossing it re-emits `VaultStatus.locked` through the existing `_emit`/`statusStream` machinery. The already-shipped AD-14 redirect (`VaultStatus` checked before `SessionStatus`) then bounces every screen back to `/vault` on that emission with zero router changes.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:** Fixed `Duration(minutes: 5)` lives in a new `features/vault/domain` file, never a shared `core/` constant, never re-tuned by any later story. Elapsed time read via an injectable `DateTime Function() now` constructor param (default `DateTime.now`) for deterministic tests. Backgrounded timestamp recorded on `AppLifecycleState.paused`, read/cleared on `AppLifecycleState.resumed` — `inactive`/`hidden` are not treated as "backgrounded" on their own. Only emits `VaultStatus.locked` when `currentStatus` is currently `unlocked` AND elapsed `>= 5` minutes — never redundantly if already locked, never before the threshold. `WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this)`/`removeObserver(this)` wired into the existing constructor/`dispose()` — no second observer, no new DI registration, no new `VaultStatus` enum value.

**Ask First:** None.

**Never:** No user-facing or account-level setting for this duration (fixed, not user-configurable — AC2). No `core/` constant. No new abstract method added to `VaultRepository`'s public contract. No changes to `app_router.dart` or `vault_lock_screen.dart` — the existing stream-driven redirect and `initState`-triggered `authenticate()` already cover re-prompting on relock.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Backgrounded < 5 min, then resumed | `paused` at T0, was `unlocked`, `resumed` at T0+4min | `currentStatus` stays `unlocked`, no emission | N/A |
| Backgrounded >= 5 min, then resumed | `paused` at T0, was `unlocked`, `resumed` at T0+5min (or later) | `statusStream` emits `locked`, `currentStatus` flips to `locked` | N/A |
| Backgrounded >= 5 min while already locked | `paused` then `resumed` after >=5min, `currentStatus` already `locked` | stays `locked`, no duplicate emission | N/A |
| `resumed` fires with no prior `paused` | e.g. first lifecycle callback ever observed | no-op, no emission, no crash | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/vault/domain/vault_idle_timeout.dart` (new) — fixed `Duration(minutes: 5)` constant, domain-owned per epic Technical Decisions.
- `lib/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl.dart` — implement `WidgetsBindingObserver`; add `_backgroundedAt`/injectable `now` clock; `WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this)` in constructor, `.removeObserver(this)` in `dispose()` (`:163-165`); override `didChangeAppLifecycleState` to apply the I/O matrix via existing `_emit`.
- `test/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl_test.dart` — add an idle-timeout `group`, calling `didChangeAppLifecycleState` directly (it's a public override) with an injected fake clock — no real `WidgetsBinding` lifecycle event needed, matching the project's "no device/simulator" constraint.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [x] `lib/features/vault/domain/vault_idle_timeout.dart` -- create the fixed-duration constant -- Technical Decisions: domain-owned, not `core/`.
- [x] `lib/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl.dart` -- implement `WidgetsBindingObserver`, injectable clock, add/removeObserver wiring, `didChangeAppLifecycleState` logic -- per I/O matrix.
- [x] `test/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl_test.dart` -- cover all four I/O matrix rows -- regression coverage for the idle re-lock.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given the app is backgrounded for less than 5 minutes, when I resume it, then no re-authentication is prompted.
- Given the app is backgrounded for 5 minutes or more, when I resume it, then re-authentication is always prompted regardless of any user setting, with the fixed 5-minute value living in `features/vault/domain`, never a shared `core/` constant.

- [x] [Review][Decision] Out-of-scope changes to `vault_lock_screen.dart` and `pin_keypad.dart` violate spec-2-3's explicit "Never" clause — this story's own frozen Boundaries say "No changes to `app_router.dart` or `vault_lock_screen.dart`," yet the diff attributed to this story (commit `81d7509`) modifies both `vault_lock_screen.dart` and the tightly-coupled `pin_keypad.dart` (the `submitPin` 10s timeout, the `PinKeypad.enabled` flag). Both are acknowledged leftover review fixes from story 2.2, bundled into this commit rather than committed separately. The idle-timeout logic itself fully complies with every other Boundary/Constraint and I/O-matrix row. — resolved: accepted as documented (see Spec Change Log below). The bundled fixes are real, correct, and already explained in `test-summary.md`/`deferred-work.md`; no code or history change made.
- [x] [Review][Patch] A biometric/PIN unlock that resolves while the app is still backgrounded can trigger an immediate re-lock the moment the app resumes — `authenticate()` uses `persistAcrossBackgrounding: true` so a pending call can resolve after a `paused` is recorded; if `_emit(unlocked)` fires while still backgrounded and `resumed` arrives ≥5 minutes after the original `paused` (e.g. a long phone call), `didChangeAppLifecycleState` immediately re-locks, bouncing the user straight back to `/vault` right after they authenticated. — fixed: `_emit` now clears `_backgroundedAt` whenever status is `unlocked`, so any unlock always resets the idle clock. Covered by a new test. [lib/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl.dart:132-151]
- [x] [Review][Patch] `submitPin()`'s UI-level 10s timeout doesn't cancel the underlying repository call, so a second attempt can race the first against the same storage key — once the UI times out and re-enables the keypad, the original `VaultRepository.submitPin()` call keeps running; if it later resolves, it can emit `unlocked` from a stale, abandoned attempt, or race a concurrent first-time PIN write with no generation/cancellation token to make a stale result a no-op. — fixed: added a `_submitPinGeneration` counter; a call whose generation is stale by the time its `read()` resolves returns `Left` without writing or emitting. Covered by a new test. [lib/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl.dart:96] [lib/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl.dart:229-243]
- [x] [Review][Patch] A second `paused` lifecycle event before any `resumed` silently resets the idle clock to the later timestamp — `didChangeAppLifecycleState` unconditionally overwrites `_backgroundedAt` on every `paused` with no check for an already-pending one, which can undercount true elapsed background time if `paused` ever fires twice without an intervening `resumed`. Not covered by the I/O matrix or tests. — fixed: `_backgroundedAt ??= _now()` keeps the earliest timestamp. Covered by a new test. [lib/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl.dart:167-173]
- [x] [Review][Patch] `PinKeypad`'s `enabled: false` state has no visual or semantic disabled treatment — taps are silently swallowed in `_onDigitTap`/`_onBackspaceTap`, but `Semantics(button: true, ...)` never sets `enabled: false` and nothing dims the buttons, so neither a sighted nor a VoiceOver user gets any "processing"/disabled cue for up to 10 seconds. — fixed: `_KeypadButton` now wraps in `Opacity` and sets `Semantics(enabled: ...)` and `onTap: null` when disabled. Covered by a new test. [lib/features/vault/presentation/widgets/pin_keypad.dart:231-282]
- [x] [Review][Patch] Stale error message lingers through a fresh PIN attempt with no "in progress" indicator — `_submitPin` never clears `_errorMessage` when a new attempt starts, so a previous mismatch/timeout message stays on screen unchanged through the new attempt. — fixed: `_errorMessage` is cleared in the same `setState` that sets `_submittingPin = true`. Covered by a new test. [lib/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen.dart:124-133]
- [x] [Review][Patch] Test file registers two `VaultRepositoryImpl` instances as `WidgetsBindingObserver` on the same shared `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding` — the top-level `setUp()`'s `repository` and the idle-timeout group's own `idleRepository` both register on the same binding, so the "real dispatch path" test's `handleAppLifecycleStateChanged(...)` notifies both simultaneously with no assertion covering the unintended side effect. Currently harmless (verified: full suite passes, `repository` never reaches `unlocked` in that group), but an unnecessary double registration. — fixed: the idle-timeout group's `setUp` now disposes the outer `repository` immediately, so only `idleRepository` is registered during this group's tests. [test/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl_test.dart]
- [x] [Review][Patch] Constructor's `WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this)` depends entirely on binding-init ordering, backed only by a comment — every current call site is correctly ordered (no live bug today), but there's no runtime assertion, so any future direct construction outside that ordering would crash with an opaque Flutter-binding error instead of a clear, intentional one. — fixed: wrapped in a `try`/`on FlutterError catch` that rethrows a `StateError` naming the actual root cause. [lib/features/vault/data/repositories/vault_repository_impl.dart:69-77]
- [x] [Review][Patch] spec-2-3's own review-tracking metadata is incomplete and internally inconsistent — frontmatter `review_loop_iteration: 0` remains at its initial value even though this file's own "Suggested Review Order" section repeatedly says "Added in review," and unlike spec-2-1/spec-2-2 in this same diff, spec-2-3 has no populated `### Review Findings` section at all until this edit. — fixed: `review_loop_iteration` bumped to `1`; this section populated. The actual reasons to prefer `DateTime` (simplicity, no new dependency) are sound; only this one stated justification is inconsistent. — fixed: reworded to drop the inconsistent justification, keeping the valid reasons. 499-**And** this story introduces a minimal Configurações screen (replacing Epic 1's placeholder) containing only this toggle — Epic 8 extends this same screen with profile editing, the dashboard, and account actions; it is never recreated from scratch.
500-
501-## Epic 3: Multimodal Capture & Processing
502-
503-Users can capture a journal Entry as text, voice, or photo — with audio transcribed on-device and photos OCR'd server-side before the Entry is ever persisted — and interrupting a capture never leaves a stray partial Entry behind.
504-
505-### Story 3.1: Text Entry Capture & Insertion Modal Shell
506-
507-As a user,
508-I want to open the "+" control and type free text to save as a journal Entry,
509-So that I can quickly capture what happened today in writing.
510-
511-**Acceptance Criteria:**
512-
513-**Given** I tap "+" on Home/Chat
514-**When** the Insertion Modal opens
515-**Then** it opens on the Texto tab by default with a three-segment tab bar (Texto/Áudio/Foto, UX-DR11) and all three tabs reset to idle/empty.
516-
517-**Given** I type text and tap Salvar
518-**When** the save completes
519-**Then** `POST /entries` fires with `source=manual` and the modal closes, returning me to where I was.
520-
--
965:**And** this story extends the minimal Configurações screen stub from Epic 2 (Story 2.4) rather than recreating it, adding the persona toggle placeholder (Analítico/Empático/Socrático cards) styled with full visual polish but with no effect on assistant behavior — a cosmetic extension-feature toggle only (UX-DR32); the screen uses `Resource<T>` (AD-12) since it is a single-source, single-fetch-lifecycle screen.
966-
967-### Story 8.2: Independent Narrative Text & Narrative-Unavailable State
968-
969-As a user,
970-I want a plain-language narrative alongside my chart, and a clear message if just the narrative fails,
971-So that I'm never confused about whether I have no data or just a broken summary.
972-
973-**Acceptance Criteria:**
974-
975-**Given** the chart has rendered with data
976-**When** `GET /dashboard/narrative` resolves
977-**Then** the narrative text appears below the chart as its own independent fetch.
978-
979-**Given** the narrative call fails while the chart has data
980-**When** this happens
981-**Then** the chart still renders normally and a distinct "narrative unavailable" message shows — never a blank space, and never confused with the zero-Entries empty state (UX-DR33).
982-
983-### Story 8.3: Profile Name Editing
984-
985-As a user,
986-I want to fix my display name inline without leaving Settings,
987-So that a quick typo fix doesn't feel like a whole separate task.
988-
989-**Acceptance Criteria:**
990-
991-**Given** I tap the pencil icon beside my name
992-**When** the field becomes editable
993-**Then** the pencil icon becomes a check icon — the only place in the product where an icon itself changes meaning rather than just color (UX-DR13).
994-
995-**Given** I edit the name and confirm
996-**When** I save
997-**Then** `PATCH /account/settings` commits the change and the field reverts to display mode.
998-
999-**Given** I tap elsewhere without confirming
1000-**When** focus leaves the field
1001-**Then** it also reverts to display mode — no separate "edit profile" screen exists.
1002-**And** the 52px Settings avatar reuses the same avatar component built in Epic 1 (Story 1.6), not a reimplementation, now at its second fixed size.

content.content:
155-| `GET /auth/session` | RF07 | — |
156-| `POST /auth/logout` | RF03 | — |
157-
158:**No "biometric-unlock" endpoint — intentional:** the Face ID / Touch ID / PIN barrier of Screen 0.1 is validated entirely on the device, never on the server. The backend only stores the preference (`biometricEnabled`, read and written via `PATCH /account/settings`, section 6.7) — it validates no biometrics. After passing the local barrier, the app uses the existing session (renewed via `POST /auth/refresh` when needed, or `POST /auth/login` if it has fully expired).
159-
160-### 6.2 Ingestion and entries
161-| Endpoint | Requirement | AI involved |
162-|---|---|---|
163-| `POST /media/ocr` — the image is not persisted; only the extracted text moves on | RF02 | Claude Haiku 4.5 (vision) |
164-| `POST /entries` — creates an entry; internally triggers the PII check and embedding generation; accepts `source` (`manual`/`audio`/`photo`/`chat`) and `chatMessageId` when the origin is the chat | RF01, RF02, RF10 | Claude Haiku 4.5 (PII) + Voyage AI (embedding) |
165-| `GET /entries` — filters by `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo`; tags appear only embedded in the response, read-only | RF07 | — |
166-| `GET /entries/:id` | RF07 | — |
167-
168-**No entry editing or deletion, and no tag endpoint — intentional:** entries are immutable once created ("original content intact, never censored"); there is no `PATCH`/`DELETE /entries/:id`. Tags are populated only by test seed data — no endpoint creates, deletes or filters by tag or category (see RF06). This is consistent with section 2: dynamic categorization was simplified to manual tags that receive no functional implementation.
169-
170-### 6.3 Chat and memory (RAG)
171-| Endpoint | Requirement | AI involved |
172-|---|---|---|
173-| `POST /chat/sessions` — blocked offline | RF04 | — |
174-| `GET /chat/sessions` — works offline (cache) | RF04, RF07 | — |
175-| `GET /chat/sessions/:id/messages` — works offline (cache) | RF04 | — |
176-| `POST /chat/sessions/:id/messages` — streaming (SSE); blocked offline | RF04 | Voyage AI (question embedding) + Claude Sonnet 5 (response) |

1	import 'dart:async';
2	
3	import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
4	import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
5	
6	import '../di/injection_container.dart';
7	import '../../features/auth/domain/entities/session_status.dart';
8	import '../../features/auth/domain/repositories/session_repository.dart';
9	import '../../features/auth/presentation/cubit/auth_cubit.dart';
10	import '../../features/auth/presentation/screens/auth_screen.dart';
11	import '../../features/vault/domain/entities/vault_status.dart';
12	import '../../features/vault/domain/repositories/vault_repository.dart';
13	import '../../features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen.dart';
14	import 'placeholder_screens.dart';
15	
16	/// Every route this app shell resolves — Story 1.6's original set
17	/// (`/boot`, `/auth`, `/reauth`, `/`, `/meus-registros`, `/planos-de-acao`,
18	/// `/configuracoes`) plus Epic 2/spec-2-1's `/vault` lock screen. Named
19	/// constants so no call site retypes a path literal that could drift from
20	/// the one `GoRouter` below.
21	abstract final class AppRoutePaths {
22	  static const boot = '/boot';
23	  static const auth = '/auth';
24	  static const reauth = '/reauth';
25	  static const vaultLock = '/vault';
26	  static const home = '/';
27	  static const meusRegistros = '/meus-registros';
28	  static const planosDeAcao = '/planos-de-acao';
29	  static const configuracoes = '/configuracoes';
30	}
31	
32	/// The epic's ONE `GoRouter`/`redirect` (Boundaries: "never a second
33	/// competing `redirect`") — composes [VaultRepository.currentStatus] first,
34	/// then [SessionRepository.currentStatus] (AD-14). Both repositories are
35	/// taken as parameters (rather than this file reaching into `sl` itself)
36	/// purely so a test can pass fakes/mocks directly, without touching the
37	/// global DI container.
38	///
39	/// [navigatorKey] is accepted explicitly (rather than letting `GoRouter`
40	/// generate its own internally) so the caller — `main.dart`'s
41	/// `ExpiryOverlayHost` — can reach the Navigator's own `BuildContext`
42	/// through the same, public, documented key instead of reaching into
43	/// `GoRouter`'s internal `routerDelegate` (not part of its public API).
44	GoRouter buildAppRouter({
45	  required VaultRepository vaultRepository,
46	  required SessionRepository sessionRepository,
47	  required GlobalKey<NavigatorState> navigatorKey,
48	}) {
49	  return GoRouter(
50	    navigatorKey: navigatorKey,
51	    initialLocation: AppRoutePaths.boot,
52	    refreshListenable: _GoRouterRefreshStream([
53	      vaultRepository.statusStream,
54	      sessionRepository.statusStream,
55	    ]),
56	    redirect: (context, state) =>
57	        _redirect(vaultRepository, sessionRepository, state),
58	    routes: [
59	      GoRoute(
60	        path: AppRoutePaths.vaultLock,
61	        builder: (context, state) =>
62	            VaultLockScreen(vaultRepository: vaultRepository),
63	      ),
64	      GoRoute(
65	        path: AppRoutePaths.boot,
66	        builder: (context, state) => const BootSplashScreen(),
67	      ),
68	      GoRoute(
69	        path: AppRoutePaths.auth,
70	        builder: (context, state) => AuthScreen(
71	          cubit: sl<AuthCubit>(),
72	          onAuthenticated: (context) => context.go(AppRoutePaths.home),
73	        ),
74	      ),
75	      GoRoute(
76	        path: AppRoutePaths.reauth,
77	        builder: (context, state) => const BiometricReauthPlaceholderScreen(),
78	      ),
79	      GoRoute(
80	        path: AppRoutePaths.home,
81	        builder: (context, state) => const HomeChatPlaceholderScreen(),
82	      ),
83	      GoRoute(
84	        path: AppRoutePaths.meusRegistros,
85	        builder: (context, state) => const MeusRegistrosPlaceholderScreen(),
86	      ),
87	      GoRoute(
88	        path: AppRoutePaths.planosDeAcao,
89	        builder: (context, state) => const ActionPlansPlaceholderScreen(),
90	      ),
91	      GoRoute(
92	        path: AppRoutePaths.configuracoes,
93	        builder: (context, state) => const ConfiguracoesPlaceholderScreen(),
94	      ),
95	    ],
96	  );
97	}
98	
99	/// I/O & Edge-Case Matrix:
100	/// - status not yet known (`null`) -> `/boot`, unless already there.
101	/// - `unauthenticated` -> `/auth`, unless already there.
102	/// - `authenticated`/`expired` -> leaves `/boot`/`/auth` for `/`; every
103	///   other location is left alone *except* `/reauth` while already
104	///   `authenticated` (bounced home below — `/reauth` is meant to be
105	///   reached only by the expiry overlay's own explicit navigation while
106	///   `expired`, code review Story 1.6) — a mid-session expiry never
107	///   navigates away (Story 1.5 behavior preserved), and the three
108	///   non-Home destinations stay reachable while `expired`.
109	///
110	/// AD-14: Epic 2's `VaultStatus` gate (RF03) is composed first, strictly
111	/// ahead of every `SessionStatus` check below — the vault gate overrides
112	/// any location whenever it isn't `unlocked`, and only once it is does the
113	/// rest of this function (unchanged from Story 1.6) ever run.
114	String? _redirect(
115	  VaultRepository vaultRepository,
116	  SessionRepository sessionRepository,
117	  GoRouterState state,
118	) {
119	  final location = state.matchedLocation;
120	
121	  // AD-14 — checked before SessionStatus, per Boundaries ("`_redirect`
122	  // checks `VaultStatus` before `SessionStatus`"). `VaultStatus.locked` is
123	  // the default from construction (never `null`), so this never waits on
124	  // an async warm-up the way the `status == null` boot check below does.
125	  if (vaultRepository.currentStatus != VaultStatus.unlocked) {
126	    return location == AppRoutePaths.vaultLock
127	        ? null
128	        : AppRoutePaths.vaultLock;
129	  }
130	
131	  final status = sessionRepository.currentStatus;
132	
133	  if (status == null) {
134	    return location == AppRoutePaths.boot ? null : AppRoutePaths.boot;
135	  }
136	
137	  if (status == SessionStatus.unauthenticated) {
138	    return location == AppRoutePaths.auth ? null : AppRoutePaths.auth;
139	  }
140	
141	  // status is authenticated or expired.
142	  // `vaultLock` is included here too: once the vault unlocks while this
143	  // location is still `/vault` (the normal cold-start path once
144	  // `authenticate()` succeeds), the same fall-through that already bounces
145	  // `/boot`/`/auth` to Home applies — `/vault` is never a valid resting
146	  // place once `VaultStatus.unlocked`.
147	  if (location == AppRoutePaths.boot ||
148	      location == AppRoutePaths.auth ||
149	      location == AppRoutePaths.vaultLock) {
150	    return AppRoutePaths.home;
151	  }
152	  // `/reauth` is a throwaway placeholder standing in for Epic 2's real

167	/// the one session stream), composing them into the one `Listenable`
168	/// `GoRouter` itself requires (Boundaries: "never a second
169	/// `GoRouter`/`redirect`").

171	  _GoRouterRefreshStream(Iterable<Stream<dynamic>> streams) {
172	    _subscriptions = [
173	      for (final stream in streams)
174	        stream.listen(
175	          (_) => notifyListeners(),
176	          // Mirrors `ExpiryOverlayHost`'s and `SessionRepositoryImpl`'s own
177	          // subscriptions to this same stream — no current implementation

7	/// (AD-14) — `core/navigation/app_router.dart`'s `_redirect` reads
8	/// [currentStatus] before it reads `SessionRepository.currentStatus`
9	/// (Boundaries: "`_redirect` checks `VaultStatus` before `SessionStatus`").
10	/// Mirrors `features/auth/domain/repositories/session_repository.dart`'s
11	/// shape, except [currentStatus] is never nullable (see [VaultStatus]'s own
12	/// doc) and there is no `restoreSession`-equivalent boot call — the vault
13	/// is always [VaultStatus.locked] until a successful [authenticate] call.
14	abstract class VaultRepository {
15	  /// Broadcast stream of the current vault status. Unlike
16	  /// `SessionRepository.statusStream`, this always has a value from the
17	  /// moment the repository is constructed ([VaultStatus.locked]) — a late
18	  /// subscriber still immediately replays that cached value, same
19	  /// `Stream.multi` rationale as the session repository's own stream.
20	  Stream<VaultStatus> get statusStream;
21	
22	  /// The last status emitted on [statusStream], read synchronously —
23	  /// starts at [VaultStatus.locked] (never `null`, see [VaultStatus]'s own
24	  /// doc) and only a successful [authenticate] call ever flips it to
25	  /// [VaultStatus.unlocked].
26	  VaultStatus get currentStatus;
27	
28	  /// Triggers the OS biometric prompt (`local_auth`, `biometricOnly: true`
29	  /// — Boundaries: "never set `biometricOnly: false`"). Zero network calls
30	  /// (Boundaries: "Vault makes zero network calls"); never produces
31	  /// [Failure.authInvalid] (reserved for password login) — any failure here
32	  /// (OS declines, cancels, or throws `LocalAuthException`) maps to
33	  /// [Failure.malformedResponse] instead, and [currentStatus] stays
34	  /// [VaultStatus.locked]. Only a `true` result flips [currentStatus] to
35	  /// [VaultStatus.unlocked] and emits it on [statusStream].
36	  Future<Either<Failure, Unit>> authenticate();
37	
38	  /// Story 2.2's biometric-failure fallback. No PIN-creation screen exists
39	  /// anywhere in `docs/input/` (Design Notes): the first call ever made to
40	  /// this method — regardless of which screen reached the keypad — stores
41	  /// [pin] as the vault's PIN and immediately succeeds; every later call
42	  /// compares [pin] against that stored value. A match (first-use or
43	  /// later) flips [currentStatus] to [VaultStatus.unlocked] and emits it on
44	  /// [statusStream], same as a successful [authenticate]. A mismatch never
45	  /// throws, never caps retries, and leaves [currentStatus] at
46	  /// [VaultStatus.locked] — [Failure.malformedResponse] is returned instead

20	      NetworkOffline;
21	  const factory Failure.validation({required String message}) = Validation;
22	  const factory Failure.piiCheckFailed({required String message}) =
23	      PiiCheckFailed;
24	  const factory Failure.embeddingFailed({required String message}) =
25	      EmbeddingFailed;
26	  const factory Failure.aiGenerationTimeout({required String message}) =

28	  const factory Failure.notFound({required String message}) = NotFound;
29	  const factory Failure.rateLimited({required String message}) = RateLimited;

78	        'RATE_LIMITED' => Failure.rateLimited(message: message),
79	        'EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD' => Failure.exportEmptyPeriod(message: message),
80	        'PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE' => Failure.payloadTooLarge(message: message),
81	        'OCR_NO_TEXT' => Failure.ocrNoText(message: message),

---
title: 'Biometric Preference Persistence'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-03'
status: 'draft'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: []
baseline_commit: '81d7509dc1b0a9be2094ef9113b73402ebf5b19f'
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** The vault's biometric gate (spec-2-1) always attempts Face ID/Touch ID first with no way to turn it off, and nothing reads or writes `biometricEnabled` server-side — Epic 1's Configurações placeholder has no real content.

**Approach:** Introduce `features/account/` with an `AccountSettingsRepository` (same synchronous-getter-plus-stream shape as `VaultRepository`/`SessionRepository`, AD-14) backed entirely by `PATCH /account/settings` — the only account-settings endpoint, used with an empty body to read and a `biometricEnabled` body to write. Fetch it once at boot and feed its current value into `VaultLockScreen` so it skips the biometric attempt when disabled, and build the real Configurações screen (replacing the placeholder) with the toggle.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:** `PATCH /account/settings` (`{FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL}/account-settings-update`) is called with `{}` to read the current preference and `{"biometricEnabled": <bool>}` to write it — no GET endpoint exists (confirmed in `openapi.yaml`). `AccountSettingsRepository.currentBiometricEnabled` starts `true` (never null) and is the single source read by both the vault gate and the Configurações toggle. Toggling is optimistic: the switch flips immediately (RNF01, <100ms), the PATCH fires, and a failure reverts the switch and shows the `Failure`'s message. `VaultLockScreen.initState` only calls `authenticate()` when the preference is `true`; when `false` it shows the PIN keypad immediately — PIN remains the access method regardless. Domain layer imports neither `flutter` nor `data/` (RNF06); repository returns `Either<Failure, T>` (RNF09).

**Ask First:** None.

**Never:** No new `Failure` subtype — `Failure.fromCode`'s existing mapping covers every PATCH error. No change to `VaultRepository`'s public contract, `vault_injection.dart`, or vault's "zero network calls" boundary — the fetch lives only in `features/account/`. No GET endpoint invented. No `displayName`/`persona` fields touched (Epic 8's scope).

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Boot fetch resolves, pref `false` | `PATCH {}` returns `biometricEnabled: false` before `/vault` builds | `VaultLockScreen` skips biometric, shows PIN keypad directly | N/A |
| Boot fetch resolves, pref `true`, or still in flight | Returns `true`, or hasn't resolved yet | `VaultLockScreen` attempts biometric first (default `true`) | N/A |
| Boot fetch fails | `PATCH {}` returns a `Failure` | `currentBiometricEnabled` stays at its prior/default value | Swallowed, fire-and-forget — mirrors `restoreSession()` |
| Toggle off, PATCH succeeds | User taps the switch | Switch flips, value persists, no error shown | N/A |
| Toggle off, PATCH fails | Network/backend error | Switch reverts to its previous value | `Failure.message` shown inline |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/account/domain/repositories/account_settings_repository.dart` (new) — `biometricEnabledStream`, `currentBiometricEnabled` (bool, starts `true`), `fetchBiometricEnabled()`, `setBiometricEnabled(bool)`, `dispose()`; mirrors `lib/features/vault/domain/repositories/vault_repository.dart`.
- `lib/features/account/data/datasources/account_remote_data_source.dart` (new) — `updateSettings({bool? biometricEnabled})` → `ApiClient.patch('account-settings-update', data: {...})`; mirrors `lib/features/auth/data/datasources/auth_remote_data_source.dart`.
- `lib/features/account/data/models/account_settings_dto.dart` (new) — minimal json_serializable DTO, only the `biometricEnabled` field of the PATCH response's `data`.
- `lib/features/account/data/repositories/account_settings_repository_impl.dart` (new) — broadcast `StreamController<bool>`, default `true`.
- `lib/features/account/account_injection.dart` (new) — `registerAccountFeature()`, called from `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart`'s `setupCoreDependencies()` (`:80-81`) next to `registerAuthFeature()`/`registerVaultFeature()`.
- `lib/features/account/presentation/cubit/account_settings_cubit.dart` (+ state, new) — wraps the repository; `toggleBiometric(bool)` does the optimistic flip/revert from the I/O matrix.
- `lib/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen.dart` (new) — header + one switch row; replaces `ConfiguracoesPlaceholderScreen`.
- `lib/core/widgets/back_arrow_header.dart` (new) — `BackArrowHeader` extracted from `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart`'s private `_BackArrowHeader` (`:247-280`) so the new screen can reuse it; `MeusRegistrosPlaceholderScreen` repointed to it.
- `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart` — delete `ConfiguracoesPlaceholderScreen` (`:165-188`).
- `lib/core/navigation/app_router.dart` — `buildAppRouter` gains `required AccountSettingsRepository accountSettingsRepository`; add its stream to `_GoRouterRefreshStream`'s list (`:52-55`); `/vault` route (`:59-63`) passes `attemptBiometricFirst: accountSettingsRepository.currentBiometricEnabled`; `/configuracoes` route (`:91-94`) builds the new screen.
- `lib/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen.dart` — add `required bool attemptBiometricFirst`; `initState` (`:72-75`) calls `_attemptAuthenticate()` only when true, else sets `_showPinKeypad = true` directly.
- `lib/main.dart` — resolve `sl<AccountSettingsRepository>()`, pass into `buildAppRouter`, fire `unawaited(fetchBiometricEnabled())` alongside the existing `restoreSession()` call (`:82-84`).

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] `lib/features/account/domain/repositories/account_settings_repository.dart` -- define the repository contract -- per Code Map.
- [ ] `lib/features/account/data/models/account_settings_dto.dart` -- minimal DTO + generated `.g.dart` -- `fvm flutter pub run build_runner build`.
- [ ] `lib/features/account/data/datasources/account_remote_data_source.dart` -- PATCH call for read (`{}`) and write (`{biometricEnabled}`) -- per Code Map.
- [ ] `lib/features/account/data/repositories/account_settings_repository_impl.dart` -- stream + sync getter, default `true` -- per Boundaries.
- [ ] `lib/features/account/account_injection.dart` + `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart` -- DI registration -- mirrors auth/vault registration.
- [ ] `lib/features/account/presentation/cubit/account_settings_cubit.dart` -- optimistic toggle + revert -- per I/O matrix.
- [ ] `lib/core/widgets/back_arrow_header.dart` -- extract from `placeholder_screens.dart` -- reuse, no duplication.
- [ ] `lib/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen.dart` -- real Configurações screen -- replaces placeholder.
- [ ] `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart`, `app_router.dart`, `main.dart` -- wire the new repository + screen, remove the placeholder -- per Code Map.
- [ ] `lib/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen.dart` -- gate `_attemptAuthenticate()` on `attemptBiometricFirst` -- per I/O matrix.
- [ ] Tests for every file above (repository, data source, cubit, screen, router, vault_lock_screen) -- cover all five I/O-matrix rows -- regression coverage.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given the Configurações screen opens, then it shows only the biometric toggle (a minimal screen Epic 8 later extends, never rebuilt from scratch).
- Given I reinstall the app or restart it after changing this setting elsewhere, when the app loads, then the preference is fetched fresh from the account, never read from a stale local-only cache.

## Design Notes

Mirrors AD-14's "stream + synchronous getter, never null" shape rather than `Resource<T>` (AD-12): this value is read persistently in two places (vault gate + settings screen), not fetched once on a single screen's entry, which is the shape `Resource<T>`'s own doc comment restricts it to. Defaulting to `true` before the boot fetch resolves exactly matches current pre-2.4 behavior, so a slow/offline fetch degrades to "try biometric first" rather than silently forcing PIN-only. The switch's active-state color reuses `DesignTokens.colorAccent` (the same "accent = active/selected" convention `pin_keypad.dart` deliberately avoids for itself) — no new design tokens.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all pass, including the new account-feature and vault_lock_screen tests.

## Intent

**Problem:** The vault's biometric gate (spec-2-1) always attempts Face ID/Touch ID first with no way to turn it off, and nothing reads or writes `biometricEnabled` server-side — Epic 1's Configurações placeholder has no real content.

**Approach:** Introduce `features/account/` with an `AccountSettingsRepository` (same synchronous-getter-plus-stream shape as `VaultRepository`/`SessionRepository`, AD-14) backed entirely by `PATCH /account/settings` — the only account-settings endpoint, used with an empty body to read and a `biometricEnabled` body to write. Fetch it once at boot and feed its current value into `VaultLockScreen` so it skips the biometric attempt when disabled, and build the real Configurações screen (replacing the placeholder) with the toggle.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:** `PATCH /account/settings` (`{FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL}/account-settings-update`) is called with `{}` to read the current preference and `{"biometricEnabled": <bool>}` to write it — no GET endpoint exists (confirmed in `openapi.yaml`). `AccountSettingsRepository.currentBiometricEnabled` starts `true` (never null) and is the single source read by both the vault gate and the Configurações toggle. Toggling is optimistic: the switch flips immediately (RNF01, <100ms), the PATCH fires, and a failure reverts the switch and shows the `Failure`'s message. `VaultLockScreen.initState` only calls `authenticate()` when the preference is `true`; when `false` it shows the PIN keypad immediately — PIN remains the access method regardless. Domain layer imports neither `flutter` nor `data/` (RNF06); repository returns `Either<Failure, T>` (RNF09).

**Ask First:** None.

**Never:** No new `Failure` subtype — `Failure.fromCode`'s existing mapping covers every PATCH error. No change to `VaultRepository`'s public contract, `vault_injection.dart`, or vault's "zero network calls" boundary — the fetch lives only in `features/account/`. No GET endpoint invented. No `displayName`/`persona` fields touched (Epic 8's scope).

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Boot fetch resolves, pref `false` | `PATCH {}` returns `biometricEnabled: false` before `/vault` builds | `VaultLockScreen` skips biometric, shows PIN keypad directly | N/A |
| Boot fetch resolves, pref `true`, or still in flight | Returns `true`, or hasn't resolved yet | `VaultLockScreen` attempts biometric first (default `true`) | N/A |
| Boot fetch fails | `PATCH {}` returns a `Failure` | `currentBiometricEnabled` stays at its prior/default value | Swallowed, fire-and-forget — mirrors `restoreSession()` |
| Toggle off, PATCH succeeds | User taps the switch | Switch flips, value persists, no error shown | N/A |
| Toggle off, PATCH fails | Network/backend error | Switch reverts to its previous value | `Failure.message` shown inline |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/account/domain/repositories/account_settings_repository.dart` (new) — `biometricEnabledStream`, `currentBiometricEnabled` (bool, starts `true`), `fetchBiometricEnabled()`, `setBiometricEnabled(bool)`, `dispose()`; mirrors `lib/features/vault/domain/repositories/vault_repository.dart`.
- `lib/features/account/data/datasources/account_remote_data_source.dart` (new) — `updateSettings({bool? biometricEnabled})` → `ApiClient.patch('account-settings-update', data: {...})`; mirrors `lib/features/auth/data/datasources/auth_remote_data_source.dart`.
- `lib/features/account/data/models/account_settings_dto.dart` (new) — minimal json_serializable DTO, only the `biometricEnabled` field of the PATCH response's `data`.
- `lib/features/account/data/repositories/account_settings_repository_impl.dart` (new) — broadcast `StreamController<bool>`, default `true`.
- `lib/features/account/account_injection.dart` (new) — `registerAccountFeature()`, called from `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart`'s `setupCoreDependencies()` (`:80-81`) next to `registerAuthFeature()`/`registerVaultFeature()`.
- `lib/features/account/presentation/cubit/account_settings_cubit.dart` (+ state, new) — wraps the repository; `toggleBiometric(bool)` does the optimistic flip/revert from the I/O matrix.
- `lib/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen.dart` (new) — header + one switch row; replaces `ConfiguracoesPlaceholderScreen`.
- `lib/core/widgets/back_arrow_header.dart` (new) — `BackArrowHeader` extracted from `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart`'s private `_BackArrowHeader` (`:247-280`) so the new screen can reuse it; `MeusRegistrosPlaceholderScreen` repointed to it.
- `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart` — delete `ConfiguracoesPlaceholderScreen` (`:165-188`).
- `lib/core/navigation/app_router.dart` — `buildAppRouter` gains `required AccountSettingsRepository accountSettingsRepository`; add its stream to `_GoRouterRefreshStream`'s list (`:52-55`); `/vault` route (`:59-63`) passes `attemptBiometricFirst: accountSettingsRepository.currentBiometricEnabled`; `/configuracoes` route (`:91-94`) builds the new screen.
- `lib/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen.dart` — add `required bool attemptBiometricFirst`; `initState` (`:72-75`) calls `_attemptAuthenticate()` only when true, else sets `_showPinKeypad = true` directly.
- `lib/main.dart` — resolve `sl<AccountSettingsRepository>()`, pass into `buildAppRouter`, fire `unawaited(fetchBiometricEnabled())` alongside the existing `restoreSession()` call (`:82-84`).

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] `lib/features/account/domain/repositories/account_settings_repository.dart` -- define the repository contract -- per Code Map.
- [ ] `lib/features/account/data/models/account_settings_dto.dart` -- minimal DTO + generated `.g.dart` -- `fvm flutter pub run build_runner build`.
- [ ] `lib/features/account/data/datasources/account_remote_data_source.dart` -- PATCH call for read (`{}`) and write (`{biometricEnabled}`) -- per Code Map.
- [ ] `lib/features/account/data/repositories/account_settings_repository_impl.dart` -- stream + sync getter, default `true` -- per Boundaries.
- [ ] `lib/features/account/account_injection.dart` + `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart` -- DI registration -- mirrors auth/vault registration.
- [ ] `lib/features/account/presentation/cubit/account_settings_cubit.dart` -- optimistic toggle + revert -- per I/O matrix.
- [ ] `lib/core/widgets/back_arrow_header.dart` -- extract from `placeholder_screens.dart` -- reuse, no duplication.
- [ ] `lib/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen.dart` -- real Configurações screen -- replaces placeholder.
- [ ] `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart`, `app_router.dart`, `main.dart` -- wire the new repository + screen, remove the placeholder -- per Code Map.
- [ ] `lib/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen.dart` -- gate `_attemptAuthenticate()` on `attemptBiometricFirst` -- per I/O matrix.
- [ ] Tests for every file above (repository, data source, cubit, screen, router, vault_lock_screen) -- cover all five I/O-matrix rows -- regression coverage.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given the Configurações screen opens, then it shows only the biometric toggle (a minimal screen Epic 8 later extends, never rebuilt from scratch).
- Given I reinstall the app or restart it after changing this setting elsewhere, when the app loads, then the preference is fetched fresh from the account, never read from a stale local-only cache.

## Design Notes

Mirrors AD-14's "stream + synchronous getter, never null" shape rather than `Resource<T>` (AD-12): this value is read persistently in two places (vault gate + settings screen), not fetched once on a single screen's entry, which is the shape `Resource<T>`'s own doc comment restricts it to. Defaulting to `true` before the boot fetch resolves exactly matches current pre-2.4 behavior, so a slow/offline fetch degrades to "try biometric first" rather than silently forcing PIN-only. The switch's active-state color reuses `DesignTokens.colorAccent` (the same "accent = active/selected" convention `pin_keypad.dart` deliberately avoids for itself) — no new design tokens.

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all pass, including the new account-feature and vault_lock_screen tests.

## Intent

**Problem:** The vault's biometric gate (spec-2-1) always attempts Face ID/Touch ID first with no way to turn it off, and nothing reads or writes `biometricEnabled` server-side — Epic 1's Configurações placeholder has no real content.

**Approach:** Introduce `features/account/` with an `AccountSettingsRepository` (synchronous-getter-plus-stream shape, like `VaultRepository`/`SessionRepository`, AD-14) backed entirely by `PATCH /account/settings` — the only account-settings endpoint, called with an empty body to read, a `biometricEnabled` body to write. Fetch once at boot, feed the current value into `VaultLockScreen` so it skips biometric when disabled, and build the real Configurações screen (replacing the placeholder) around the toggle.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:** `PATCH /account/settings` (`{FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL}/account-settings-update`) is called with `{}` to read the current preference and `{"biometricEnabled": <bool>}` to write it — no GET endpoint exists (confirmed in `openapi.yaml`). `AccountSettingsRepository.currentBiometricEnabled` starts `true` (never null) and is the single source read by both the vault gate and the Configurações toggle. Toggling is optimistic: the switch flips immediately (RNF01, <100ms), the PATCH fires, and a failure reverts the switch and shows the `Failure`'s message. `VaultLockScreen.initState` only calls `authenticate()` when the preference is `true`; when `false` it shows the PIN keypad immediately — PIN remains the access method regardless. Domain layer imports neither `flutter` nor `data/` (RNF06); repository returns `Either<Failure, T>` (RNF09).

**Ask First:** None.

**Never:** No new `Failure` subtype — `Failure.fromCode`'s existing mapping covers every PATCH error. No change to `VaultRepository`'s public contract, `vault_injection.dart`, or vault's "zero network calls" boundary — the fetch lives only in `features/account/`. No GET endpoint invented. No `displayName`/`persona` fields touched (Epic 8's scope).

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Boot fetch resolves, pref `false` | `PATCH {}` returns `biometricEnabled: false` before `/vault` builds | `VaultLockScreen` skips biometric, shows PIN keypad directly | N/A |
| Boot fetch resolves, pref `true`, or still in flight | Returns `true`, or hasn't resolved yet | `VaultLockScreen` attempts biometric first (default `true`) | N/A |
| Boot fetch fails | `PATCH {}` returns a `Failure` | `currentBiometricEnabled` stays at its prior/default value | Swallowed, fire-and-forget — mirrors `restoreSession()` |
| Toggle off, PATCH succeeds | User taps the switch | Switch flips, value persists, no error shown | N/A |
| Toggle off, PATCH fails | Network/backend error | Switch reverts to its previous value | `Failure.message` shown inline |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/account/domain/repositories/account_settings_repository.dart` (new) — `biometricEnabledStream`, `currentBiometricEnabled` (bool, starts `true`), `fetchBiometricEnabled()`, `setBiometricEnabled(bool)`, `dispose()`; mirrors `vault_repository.dart`.
- `lib/features/account/data/datasources/account_remote_data_source.dart` (new) — `updateSettings({bool? biometricEnabled})` → `ApiClient.patch('account-settings-update', data: {...})`; mirrors `auth_remote_data_source.dart`.
- `lib/features/account/data/models/account_settings_dto.dart` (new) — minimal json_serializable DTO, only the response's `biometricEnabled` field.
- `lib/features/account/data/repositories/account_settings_repository_impl.dart` (new) — broadcast `StreamController<bool>`, default `true`.
- `lib/features/account/account_injection.dart` (new) — `registerAccountFeature()`, called from `injection_container.dart`'s `setupCoreDependencies()` (`:80-81`) next to the auth/vault registrations.
- `lib/features/account/presentation/cubit/account_settings_cubit.dart` (+ state, new) — wraps the repository; `toggleBiometric(bool)` is the optimistic flip/revert from the I/O matrix.
- `lib/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen.dart` (new) — header + one switch row; replaces `ConfiguracoesPlaceholderScreen`.
- `lib/core/widgets/back_arrow_header.dart` (new) — `BackArrowHeader` extracted from `placeholder_screens.dart`'s private `_BackArrowHeader` (`:247-280`); `MeusRegistrosPlaceholderScreen` repointed to it.
- `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart` — delete `ConfiguracoesPlaceholderScreen` (`:165-188`).
- `lib/core/navigation/app_router.dart` — `buildAppRouter` gains `required AccountSettingsRepository accountSettingsRepository`; its stream joins `_GoRouterRefreshStream` (`:52-55`); `/vault` (`:59-63`) passes `attemptBiometricFirst: accountSettingsRepository.currentBiometricEnabled`; `/configuracoes` (`:91-94`) builds the new screen.
- `lib/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen.dart` — add `required bool attemptBiometricFirst`; `initState` (`:72-75`) calls `_attemptAuthenticate()` only when true, else sets `_showPinKeypad = true` directly.
- `lib/main.dart` — resolve `sl<AccountSettingsRepository>()`, pass into `buildAppRouter`, fire `unawaited(fetchBiometricEnabled())` alongside the existing `restoreSession()` call (`:82-84`).

**Execution:**
- [ ] Account domain/data/DI files above -- new `features/account/` module -- per Code Map.
- [ ] `account_settings_cubit.dart` + `account_settings_screen.dart` -- optimistic toggle UI -- per I/O matrix.
- [ ] `back_arrow_header.dart` extraction -- reuse, no duplication -- per Code Map.
- [ ] `placeholder_screens.dart`, `app_router.dart`, `main.dart` -- wire the new repository + screen, remove the placeholder -- per Code Map.
- [ ] `vault_lock_screen.dart` -- gate `_attemptAuthenticate()` on `attemptBiometricFirst` -- per I/O matrix.
- [ ] Tests for every file above -- cover all five I/O-matrix rows -- regression coverage.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given the Configurações screen opens, then it shows only the biometric toggle (a minimal screen Epic 8 later extends, never rebuilt from scratch).
- Given I reinstall the app or restart it after changing this setting elsewhere, when the app loads, then the preference is fetched fresh from the account, never read from a stale local-only cache.

## Design Notes

Mirrors AD-14's "stream + synchronous getter, never null" shape rather than `Resource<T>` (AD-12): this value is read persistently in two places (vault gate + settings screen), not fetched once on a single screen's entry, which is the shape `Resource<T>`'s own doc comment restricts it to. Defaulting to `true` before the boot fetch resolves exactly matches current pre-2.4 behavior, so a slow/offline fetch degrades to "try biometric first" rather than silently forcing PIN-only. The switch's active-state color reuses `DesignTokens.colorAccent` (the same "accent = active/selected" convention `pin_keypad.dart` deliberately avoids for itself) — no new design tokens.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all pass, including the new account-feature and vault_lock_screen tests.

type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-03'

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** The vault's biometric gate (spec-2-1) always attempts Face ID/Touch ID first with no way to turn it off, and nothing reads or writes `biometricEnabled` server-side — Epic 1's Configurações placeholder has no real content.

**Approach:** Introduce `features/account/` with an `AccountSettingsRepository` (synchronous-getter-plus-stream shape, like `VaultRepository`/`SessionRepository`, AD-14) backed entirely by `PATCH /account/settings` — the only account-settings endpoint, called with an empty body to read, a `biometricEnabled` body to write. Fetch once at boot, feed the current value into `VaultLockScreen` so it skips biometric when disabled, and build the real Configurações screen (replacing the placeholder) around the toggle.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:** `PATCH /account/settings` (`{FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL}/account-settings-update`) is called with `{}` to read and `{"biometricEnabled": <bool>}` to write — no GET endpoint exists (confirmed in `openapi.yaml`). `AccountSettingsRepository.currentBiometricEnabled` starts `true` (never null), the single source read by both the vault gate and the toggle. Toggling is optimistic: the switch flips immediately (RNF01, <100ms), the PATCH fires, a failure reverts the switch and shows the `Failure`'s message. `VaultLockScreen.initState` calls `authenticate()` only when the preference is `true`; `false` shows the PIN keypad immediately — PIN remains the access method regardless. Domain imports neither `flutter` nor `data/` (RNF06); repository returns `Either<Failure, T>` (RNF09).

**Ask First:** None.

**Never:** No new `Failure` subtype — `Failure.fromCode`'s existing mapping covers every PATCH error. No change to `VaultRepository`'s public contract, `vault_injection.dart`, or vault's "zero network calls" boundary — the fetch lives only in `features/account/`. No GET endpoint invented. No `displayName`/`persona` fields touched (Epic 8's scope).

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Boot fetch resolves, pref `false` | `PATCH {}` returns `biometricEnabled: false` before `/vault` builds | `VaultLockScreen` skips biometric, shows PIN keypad directly | N/A |
| Boot fetch resolves, pref `true`, or still in flight | Returns `true`, or hasn't resolved yet | `VaultLockScreen` attempts biometric first (default `true`) | N/A |
| Boot fetch fails | `PATCH {}` returns a `Failure` | `currentBiometricEnabled` stays at its prior/default value | Swallowed, fire-and-forget — mirrors `restoreSession()` |
| Toggle off, PATCH succeeds | User taps the switch | Switch flips, value persists, no error shown | N/A |
| Toggle off, PATCH fails | Network/backend error | Switch reverts to its previous value | `Failure.message` shown inline |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/account/domain/repositories/account_settings_repository.dart` (new) — `biometricEnabledStream`, `currentBiometricEnabled` (bool, starts `true`), `fetchBiometricEnabled()`, `setBiometricEnabled(bool)`, `dispose()`; mirrors `vault_repository.dart`.
- `lib/features/account/data/datasources/account_remote_data_source.dart` (new) — `updateSettings({bool? biometricEnabled})` → `ApiClient.patch('account-settings-update', data: {...})`; mirrors `auth_remote_data_source.dart`.
- `lib/features/account/data/models/account_settings_dto.dart` (new) — minimal json_serializable DTO, only the response's `biometricEnabled` field.
- `lib/features/account/data/repositories/account_settings_repository_impl.dart` (new) — broadcast `StreamController<bool>`, default `true`.
- `lib/features/account/account_injection.dart` (new) — `registerAccountFeature()`, called from `injection_container.dart`'s `setupCoreDependencies()` (`:80-81`) next to the auth/vault registrations.
- `lib/features/account/presentation/cubit/account_settings_cubit.dart` (+ state, new) — wraps the repository; `toggleBiometric(bool)` is the optimistic flip/revert from the I/O matrix.
- `lib/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen.dart` (new) — header + one switch row; replaces `ConfiguracoesPlaceholderScreen`.
- `lib/core/widgets/back_arrow_header.dart` (new) — `BackArrowHeader` extracted from `placeholder_screens.dart`'s private `_BackArrowHeader` (`:247-280`); `MeusRegistrosPlaceholderScreen` repointed to it.
- `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart` — delete `ConfiguracoesPlaceholderScreen` (`:165-188`).
- `lib/core/navigation/app_router.dart` — `buildAppRouter` gains `required AccountSettingsRepository accountSettingsRepository`; its stream joins `_GoRouterRefreshStream` (`:52-55`); `/vault` (`:59-63`) passes `attemptBiometricFirst: accountSettingsRepository.currentBiometricEnabled`; `/configuracoes` (`:91-94`) builds the new screen.
- `lib/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen.dart` — add `required bool attemptBiometricFirst`; `initState` (`:72-75`) calls `_attemptAuthenticate()` only when true, else sets `_showPinKeypad = true` directly.
- `lib/main.dart` — resolve `sl<AccountSettingsRepository>()`, pass into `buildAppRouter`, fire `unawaited(fetchBiometricEnabled())` alongside the existing `restoreSession()` call (`:82-84`).

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] Account domain/data/DI files above -- new `features/account/` module -- per Code Map.
- [ ] `account_settings_cubit.dart` + `account_settings_screen.dart` -- optimistic toggle UI -- per I/O matrix.
- [ ] `back_arrow_header.dart` extraction -- reuse, no duplication -- per Code Map.
- [ ] `placeholder_screens.dart`, `app_router.dart`, `main.dart` -- wire the new repository + screen, remove the placeholder -- per Code Map.
- [ ] `vault_lock_screen.dart` -- gate `_attemptAuthenticate()` on `attemptBiometricFirst` -- per I/O matrix.
- [ ] Tests for every file above -- cover all five I/O-matrix rows -- regression coverage.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given the Configurações screen opens, then it shows only the biometric toggle (a minimal screen Epic 8 later extends, never rebuilt from scratch).
- Given I reinstall the app or restart it after changing this setting elsewhere, when the app loads, then the preference is fetched fresh from the account, never read from a stale local-only cache.

## Design Notes

Mirrors AD-14's stream-plus-sync-getter shape rather than `Resource<T>` (AD-12): this value is read persistently in two places (vault gate + settings screen), not fetched once on a single screen's entry — the shape `Resource<T>`'s own doc restricts it to. Defaulting to `true` before the boot fetch resolves matches current pre-2.4 behavior, so a slow/offline fetch degrades to "try biometric first", never silent PIN-only. Switch active color reuses `DesignTokens.colorAccent` (the "accent = active" convention `pin_keypad.dart` deliberately avoids for itself) — no new tokens.

- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all pass, including the new account-feature and vault_lock_screen tests.
